comparison.objective: Locate a DC earth fault by sectionalizing fuse circuits; candidate commissions a mechanical damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential fuse extraction/reinsertion with meter observation versus tool-mediated mechanical adjustment and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Finish with only the faulty feeder isolated and never two healthy circuits open; no separate spec file or complete numeric rubric is indexed. Candidate requires two safe locked cycles but leaves some response limits undeclared.
comparison.reason: Both iterate from observed feedback, but electrical fault isolation and mechanical damping optimization test materially different abilities.
